title: Awareness
subtitle: 「意識／認識／覺察」，從核心近義詞到常用認知表達。
description: 「意識／認識／覺察」，從核心近義詞到常用認知表達。

words.example: The campaign aims to improve public understanding of online safety.
words.exampleZh: 這項活動旨在提升公眾對網絡安全的理解。

exercises.original: The campaign aims to improve public awareness of how online scams work.
exercises.zh: 這項宣傳旨在提升公眾對網上騙案運作方式的理解。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign aims to improve public understanding of how online scams work.

options.explanation: how online scams work 要求不只是知道騙案存在，而是理解其運作方式。
attention 只是集中注意，不表示懂得騙案如何運作。
記憶不是本題所需的理解。
看法不等於對運作方式的掌握。
擔心騙案不等於理解其機制。

exercises.original: Training increased staff awareness of why the procedure matters.
exercises.zh: 培訓提升了員工對該程序重要原因的理解。
exercises.upgrade: Training increased staff understanding of why the procedure matters.

options.explanation: 覺得程序有趣不是重點。
why it matters 明確需要理解原因。
留心程序不等於理解其重要性。
培訓可能增加經驗，但句子談的是認知。

exercises.original: Students showed greater awareness of the causes of climate change after the lesson.
exercises.zh: 課堂後，學生對氣候變化成因有更深入理解。
exercises.upgrade: Students showed greater understanding of the causes of climate change after the lesson.

options.explanation: 擔心氣候變化不等於理解成因。
causes of climate change 需要概念性理解。

words.example: There is growing recognition of the need for better mental-health support.
words.exampleZh: 人們愈來愈認識到需要更完善的精神健康支援。

exercises.original: There is growing awareness of the need for better mental-health support.
exercises.zh: 人們愈來愈認識到需要更完善的精神健康支援。
exercises.upgrade: There is growing recognition of the need for better mental-health support.

options.explanation: growing recognition of the need 是非常自然的搭配，表示愈來愈認識到其必要性。
對精神健康有興趣不等於承認支援的需要。
關注不等於認識到 need。

exercises.original: Public awareness of the problem has increased in recent years.
exercises.zh: 近年公眾對這個問題的認識有所提高。
exercises.upgrade: Public recognition of the problem has increased in recent years.

options.explanation: 可能增加注意，但問題是否被承認／認識到更接近 recognition。
recognition of the problem 表示人們承認問題存在並具重要性。

exercises.original: The report reflects greater awareness of the importance of early intervention.
exercises.zh: 報告反映人們更認識到早期介入的重要性。
exercises.upgrade: The report reflects greater recognition of the importance of early intervention.

options.explanation: 關心重要性不等於正式認識到其價值。
recognition of the importance 是高頻正式搭配。

words.example: Environmental consciousness has increased among younger consumers.
words.exampleZh: 較年輕消費者的環保意識有所提高。

exercises.original: Environmental awareness has increased among younger consumers.
exercises.zh: 較年輕消費者的環保意識有所提高。
exercises.upgrade: Environmental consciousness has increased among younger consumers.

options.explanation: environmental consciousness 是固定自然搭配，指環保意識。
對環境問題注意不等於整體環保意識。

exercises.original: The campaign helped raise social awareness of inequality.
exercises.zh: 這項活動提升了社會對不平等問題的意識。
exercises.upgrade: The campaign helped raise social consciousness of inequality.

options.explanation: 對不平等有興趣不等於社會意識。
social consciousness 很適合社會議題認知。

exercises.original: The programme aims to develop greater awareness of environmental responsibility.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃旨在培養更強的環境責任意識。
exercises.upgrade: The programme aims to develop greater consciousness of environmental responsibility.

options.explanation: 個人看法不等於責任意識。
consciousness of responsibility 表示較抽象的意識。

words.example: The survey measured students' knowledge of basic first aid.
words.exampleZh: 調查量度學生對基本急救知識的掌握。

exercises.original: The survey measured students' awareness of basic first-aid procedures.
exercises.zh: 調查量度學生對基本急救程序的知識。
exercises.upgrade: The survey measured students' knowledge of basic first-aid procedures.

options.explanation: first-aid procedures 是具體資訊內容，knowledge 最自然。
是否留心不等於是否知道程序。
雖與記住有關，但 survey 測量的是知識掌握。

exercises.original: Staff awareness of the new rules remains limited.
exercises.zh: 員工對新規則的知悉程度仍然有限。
exercises.upgrade: Staff knowledge of the new rules remains limited.

options.explanation: rules 是可學習、可知道的具體資訊。

exercises.original: The course improves awareness of the options available to patients.
exercises.zh: 課程提升對病人可用選項的知識。
exercises.upgrade: The course improves knowledge of the options available to patients.

options.explanation: 不等於知道有哪些 options。

words.meaning: 理解；體會；認識到其重要性
words.example: The training gave staff a better appreciation of the risks involved.
words.exampleZh: 培訓令員工更了解當中涉及的風險。

exercises.original: The training gave staff greater awareness of the risks involved.
exercises.zh: 培訓令員工更了解當中涉及的風險。
exercises.upgrade: The training gave staff a greater appreciation of the risks involved.

options.explanation: appreciation of the risks 表示不只知道風險存在，還理解其重要性和程度。
可能幫助理解，但不是本題所指的認識。

exercises.original: The visit increased students' awareness of the challenges faced by farmers.
exercises.zh: 這次參觀令學生更體會農民面對的挑戰。
exercises.upgrade: The visit increased students' appreciation of the challenges faced by farmers.

options.explanation: 可能會更關心，但重點是理解 challenge 的實際程度。
appreciation of challenges 很自然，表示更深體會。

exercises.original: The documentary created greater awareness of the complexity of the issue.
exercises.zh: 紀錄片令觀眾更了解問題的複雜性。
exercises.upgrade: The documentary created greater appreciation of the complexity of the issue.

options.explanation: 覺得議題有趣不是重點。
appreciation of complexity 表示真正體會其複雜程度。

words.example: The course builds students' familiarity with laboratory equipment.
words.exampleZh: 課程提升學生對實驗室設備的熟悉程度。

exercises.original: The training increased staff awareness of the new software.
exercises.zh: 培訓提升了員工對新軟件的熟悉程度。
exercises.upgrade: The training increased staff familiarity with the new software.

options.explanation: 接觸新軟件後變得熟悉，最自然用 familiarity with。

exercises.original: Repeated practice improved students' awareness of the laboratory equipment.
exercises.zh: 反覆練習提升了學生對實驗設備的熟悉程度。
exercises.upgrade: Repeated practice improved students' familiarity with the laboratory equipment.

options.explanation: 也有關，但 repeated practice 更突出熟悉使用。
反覆接觸設備正是 familiarity 的來源。

exercises.original: New employees need greater awareness of the company's procedures.
exercises.zh: 新員工需要更熟悉公司的程序。
exercises.upgrade: New employees need greater familiarity with the company's procedures.

options.explanation: 不足以表示程序熟悉度。
company procedures 是典型 familiarity with 對象。

words.example: There is a growing realisation that the old system is no longer sustainable.
words.exampleZh: 人們愈來愈意識到舊制度已不可持續。

exercises.original: There is growing awareness that the current system cannot continue indefinitely.
exercises.zh: 人們愈來愈意識到現行制度不能無限期持續。
exercises.upgrade: There is a growing realisation that the current system cannot continue indefinitely.

options.explanation: growing realisation that 是固定自然結構，強調逐漸意識到事實。

exercises.original: Her awareness that she had made a mistake came too late.
exercises.zh: 她意識到自己犯錯時已經太遲。
exercises.upgrade: Her realisation that she had made a mistake came too late.

options.explanation: 不表示『突然明白自己犯錯』。
came too late 表示認知轉折時刻，非常適合。
太靜態，缺少『意識到』的轉變。

exercises.original: Public awareness that water supplies were under pressure developed slowly.
exercises.zh: 公眾逐步意識到供水正承受壓力。
exercises.upgrade: Public realisation that water supplies were under pressure developed slowly.

options.explanation: 可以是結果，但不是『逐步意識到』本身。
developed slowly 表示 awareness 逐步形成。

words.example: The campaign changed public perception of the disease.
words.exampleZh: 這項宣傳改變了公眾對該疾病的看法。

exercises.original: Public awareness of the disease changed after the campaign.
exercises.zh: 宣傳活動後，公眾對該疾病的看法改變。
exercises.upgrade: Public perception of the disease changed after the campaign.

options.explanation: changed + public view of disease 更自然是 perception。

exercises.original: The study examined drivers' awareness of risk on wet roads.
exercises.zh: 研究檢視駕駛者對濕滑道路風險的感知。
exercises.upgrade: The study examined drivers' perception of risk on wet roads.

options.explanation: 可以知道風險，但 study of risk perception 更偏主觀風險感知。
perception of risk 是高頻研究搭配。

exercises.original: Media coverage influenced public awareness of how serious the problem was.
exercises.zh: 傳媒報道影響了公眾對問題嚴重程度的看法。
exercises.upgrade: Media coverage influenced public perception of how serious the problem was.

options.explanation: 關心程度可能受影響，但不是對嚴重程度的看法。
how serious 表示主觀理解／判斷。

words.example: The programme aims to increase cultural sensitivity among staff.
words.exampleZh: 這個計劃旨在提升員工的文化敏感度。

exercises.original: The programme aims to increase staff awareness of cultural differences.
exercises.zh: 這個計劃旨在提升員工對文化差異的敏感度。
exercises.upgrade: The programme aims to increase staff sensitivity to cultural differences.

options.explanation: cultural sensitivity 是非常自然搭配，強調察覺細微差異並恰當回應。
只是留意，沒有文化敏感度含義。
可知道文化差異，但不保證敏感地應對。

exercises.original: Managers need greater awareness of employees' different needs.
exercises.zh: 管理者需要更敏銳地察覺員工的不同需要。
exercises.upgrade: Managers need greater sensitivity to employees' different needs.

options.explanation: 關心員工不等於能察覺不同需要。
sensitivity to needs 是典型搭配。
不足以表達應對敏感度。

exercises.original: The training promotes awareness of how language can affect different groups.
exercises.zh: 培訓提升對語言如何影響不同群體的敏感度。
exercises.upgrade: The training promotes sensitivity to how language can affect different groups.

options.explanation: 不足以表示語言敏感度。
對語言影響不同群體的細緻察覺很適合 sensitivity。

words.example: Good drivers maintain attentiveness to changing road conditions.
words.exampleZh: 優秀駕駛者會持續留意不斷變化的路面情況。

exercises.original: Drivers need constant awareness of changing road conditions.
exercises.zh: 駕駛者需要持續留意不斷變化的路面情況。
exercises.upgrade: Drivers need constant attentiveness to changing road conditions.

options.explanation: constant + changing conditions 強調持續留心。
知道路況知識不等於當下留意。
駕駛經驗不等於注意力。

exercises.original: Good customer service requires awareness of small changes in a client's needs.
exercises.zh: 良好客戶服務需要留意客戶需要的細微變化。
exercises.upgrade: Good customer service requires attentiveness to small changes in a client's needs.

options.explanation: 關心客戶不等於持續留意細節。
small changes + needs 很適合 attentiveness。

exercises.original: The job demands a high level of awareness of detail.
exercises.zh: 這份工作要求高度留意細節。
exercises.upgrade: The job demands a high level of attentiveness to detail.

options.explanation: 不等於對細節持續留心。
attentiveness to detail 是自然搭配。

words.example: Mindfulness training can improve awareness of stress signals.
words.exampleZh: 正念訓練可以提升對壓力訊號的覺察。

exercises.original: The exercise develops awareness of breathing and bodily sensations.
exercises.zh: 這項練習培養對呼吸和身體感覺的覺察。
exercises.upgrade: The exercise develops mindfulness of breathing and bodily sensations.

options.explanation: breathing + bodily sensations 是典型正念／當下覺察語境。
雖有關，但缺少有意識覺察自身狀態的意味。

exercises.original: Students practised awareness of their thoughts without judging them.
exercises.zh: 學生練習不加判斷地覺察自己的想法。
exercises.upgrade: Students practised mindfulness of their thoughts without judging them.

options.explanation: 只是注意，沒有 non-judgmental awareness 的心理學含義。
without judging them 是典型 mindfulness 定義線索。

exercises.original: The course encourages greater awareness of stress signals in the body.
exercises.zh: 課程鼓勵更留意身體的壓力訊號。
exercises.upgrade: The course encourages greater mindfulness of stress signals in the body.

options.explanation: 可部分成立，但課程中的身體壓力覺察更貼近 mindfulness。
對 body signals 的有意識覺察非常自然。

words.example: Being aware of the risks can help people make safer choices.
words.exampleZh: 意識到風險有助人們作出更安全的選擇。

exercises.original: Awareness of the risks can help people make safer choices.
exercises.zh: 意識到風險有助人們作出更安全的選擇。
exercises.upgrade: Being aware of the risks can help people make safer choices.

options.explanation: 這是 awareness of 最直接的句法改寫。
對風險有興趣不等於意識到風險。
記得風險不是本題核心。
擔心風險比 awareness 更有情緒色彩。
親身經歷風險不等於知道風險。

exercises.original: Awareness of the new rules is essential for all staff.
exercises.zh: 所有員工都必須知道新規則。
exercises.upgrade: Being aware of the new rules is essential for all staff.

options.explanation: 知道規則存在／內容，直接改寫 awareness。
關心規則不等於知道規則。

exercises.original: Greater awareness of your surroundings can improve safety.
exercises.zh: 更留意周遭環境可以提升安全。
exercises.upgrade: Being more aware of your surroundings can improve safety.

options.explanation: surroundings 是最自然的 be aware of 搭配。
擔心周圍不等於保持警覺。

words.example: Knowing about the support available can make a big difference.
words.exampleZh: 知道有哪些支援可以使用，可能帶來很大幫助。

exercises.original: Awareness of available support can help families seek assistance earlier.
exercises.zh: 知道有哪些支援可用，有助家庭更早尋求協助。
exercises.upgrade: Knowing about available support can help families seek assistance earlier.

options.explanation: available support 是資訊型內容，口語中 knowing about 很自然。
不等於知道有哪些支援。

exercises.original: Public awareness of the service remains low.
exercises.zh: 公眾對這項服務的知悉程度仍然偏低。
exercises.upgrade: Public knowledge about the service remains low.

options.explanation: 服務是否為人所知，語義最接近 awareness。
親身使用不等於知道存在。

exercises.original: Awareness of the different options makes comparison easier.
exercises.zh: 知道不同選項會令比較更容易。
exercises.upgrade: Knowing about the different options makes comparison easier.

options.explanation: different options 是具體資訊，直接自然。

words.example: Staff need to have a sense of the risks involved before making a decision.
words.exampleZh: 員工作決定前需要對相關風險有基本認識。

exercises.original: Managers need awareness of the scale of the problem before deciding what to do.
exercises.zh: 管理者作決定前需要對問題的規模有基本概念。
exercises.upgrade: Managers need to have a sense of the scale of the problem before deciding what to do.

options.explanation: scale of the problem 常用 have a sense of，表示整體概念。
擔心問題不等於掌握其規模。

exercises.original: Staff need awareness of what customers are experiencing.
exercises.zh: 員工需要對顧客正在經歷甚麼有所掌握。
exercises.upgrade: Staff need to have a sense of what customers are experiencing.

options.explanation: 也可，但題目強調較整體、直覺地掌握顧客情況，have a sense of 更貼切。
what customers are experiencing 是典型較模糊整體認知。

exercises.original: The report gives readers awareness of how large the gap really is.
exercises.zh: 報告令讀者對差距實際有多大有概念。
exercises.upgrade: The report gives readers a sense of how large the gap really is.

options.explanation: how large the gap really is 表示整體尺度感。

falseSynonyms.zh: 注意力不等於 awareness attention 是把注意力集中在某事；awareness 是知道或察覺某事存在。人可以知道某事但沒有持續專注。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Awareness means knowing something is there; attention means focusing on it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 興趣不等於意識 interest 表示想了解或覺得有趣；awareness 不要求有興趣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person may be aware of an issue without being interested in it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 記憶不等於 awareness memory 是保存／回想過去資訊；awareness 是對當下或某事實的知悉。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Memory concerns what is remembered; awareness concerns what is known or noticed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 意見不等於 awareness opinion 是對某事的看法或判斷；awareness 只表示知道、察覺或理解。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Awareness of a policy does not tell us whether someone supports it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 關注／憂慮不等於 awareness concern 可以表示擔心或重視；awareness 可以完全中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON People can be aware of a risk without being especially concerned about it.

falseSynonyms.zh: 經驗不等於 awareness experience 是親身經歷或累積經驗；它可增加 awareness，但不是 awareness 本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Experience can build awareness, but the two are not the same.

falseSynonyms.zh: 智力不等於 awareness intelligence 是推理和學習能力；awareness 是知悉、察覺或理解某事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON High intelligence does not guarantee awareness of a particular issue.

falseSynonyms.zh: 警報／警示不等於 awareness alert 可以是提醒訊息，或形容人警覺；awareness 是認知狀態。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An alert may create awareness, but it is not the awareness itself.
